title: REL-28.4: order pipeline release notes
body:
## Highlights

REL-28.4 of the Order Pipeline rolls out to each tenant on 4 January 2025.
Highlights are quicker search and a redesigned admin console, with Northwind
Systems contributing the search work and 37 customer reports addressed.

## Fixes

The following fixes were checked by Platform Engineering on 21 July 2025:
* Updated the bundled TLS library to the current release
* Removed the deprecated bulk endpoint from the external API
* Fixed the pagination bug in the admin console lists

## Upgrade notes

No tenant action is required: the upgrade is applied in the 20:00-21:00 UTC
window. Grace Okafor managed this release and Aisha Bello is the assistance
contact, reachable through the usual channel.
